scripts.build:preview: rm -rf dist && bun run generate:cn && bun run content && CLOUDFLARE_ENV=preview vp build --mode preview && bun scripts/verify-build.ts preview && bun scripts/optimize-prerendered-html.ts
scripts.build:production: rm -rf dist && bun run generate:cn && bun run content && CLOUDFLARE_ENV=production vp build --mode production && bun scripts/verify-build.ts production && bun scripts/optimize-prerendered-html.ts
scripts.build:test: rm -rf dist && bun run generate:cn && bun run content && CLOUDFLARE_ENV=test vp build --mode test && bun scripts/verify-build.ts test && bun scripts/optimize-prerendered-html.ts
scripts.cf-typegen: vp exec wrangler types --env development src/types/worker-configuration.d.ts
scripts.check: bun run generate:cn && bun run check:i18n && vp check
scripts.check:fix: bun run generate:cn && bun run check:i18n && vp check --fix
scripts.check:i18n: bun scripts/check-i18n.ts && bun scripts/check-message-formats.ts && bun scripts/check-content.ts
scripts.check:pre-commit: bun run generate:cn && bun run check:i18n && vp staged
scripts.clean: rm -rf .source .tanstack .wrangler dist coverage playwright-report test-results blob-report *.tsbuildinfo
scripts.clean:hardcore: bun run clean:deep && rm -rf bun.lock skills-lock.json
scripts.db:migrate:development: vp exec wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env development --remote
scripts.db:migrate:local: vp exec wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env development --local
scripts.db:migrate:preview: vp exec wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env preview --remote
scripts.db:migrate:production: vp exec wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env production --remote
scripts.db:migrate:test: vp exec wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env test --local --persist-to .wrangler/test
scripts.db:migrations:development: vp exec wrangler d1 migrations list DB --env development --remote
scripts.db:migrations:preview: vp exec wrangler d1 migrations list DB --env preview --remote
scripts.db:migrations:production: vp exec wrangler d1 migrations list DB --env production --remote
scripts.db:reset:test: rm -rf .wrangler/test && bun run db:migrate:test && bun run db:seed:test
scripts.deploy:preview: bun scripts/verify-bindings.ts preview && bun run polar:verify:preview && bun run build:preview && bun scripts/prepare-deploy-secrets.ts preview && bun run db:migrate:preview && env -u CLOUDFLARE_ENV vp exec wrangler deploy --config dist/server/wrangler.json --secrets-file .wrangler/secrets.preview.json && bun scripts/verify-deployment.ts preview
scripts.deploy:production: bun scripts/verify-bindings.ts production && bun run polar:verify:production && bun run build:production && bun scripts/prepare-deploy-secrets.ts production && bun run db:migrate:production && env -u CLOUDFLARE_ENV vp exec wrangler deploy --config dist/server/wrangler.json --secrets-file .wrangler/secrets.production.json && bun scripts/verify-deployment.ts production
scripts.dev: bun run generate:cn && bun run content && CLOUDFLARE_ENV=development vp dev
scripts.prepare: vp config --no-agent && bun run generate:cn && bun run content
scripts.test:all: bun run test && bun run test:e2e:smoke
scripts.typegen: bun run cf-typegen && bun run generate:cn && bun run content
